description: This Java source file defines the class DriverFactory, which manages creation and management of WebDriver instances for different browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) in a test automation context. It handles driver setup, browser options, and driver lifecycle.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods to create, retrieve, and quit WebDriver instances, supporting multiple browsers and encapsulating driver setup and configuration.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Returns the current thread's WebDriver instance. Throws an exception if the driver is not initialized.

methods.name: createDriver
methods.description: Initializes a new WebDriver instance based on the configured browser type and options, and stores it in thread-local storage.

methods.name: quitDriver
methods.description: Quits and cleans up the WebDriver instance for the current thread.

methods.name: resolveChromeBinaryPath
methods.description: Attempts to locate an appropriate Chrome/Chromium binary from configuration or common system paths.

methods.name: validateExecutable
methods.description: Checks if a given path points to an existing, executable file, returning its absolute path if valid.
